title: Love Never Fails
reflection: Today, choose love even when it is difficult.
prayer: Lord, help me walk in love today. Amen.

title: Trust God With All Your Heart
verse: Trust in the Lord with all your heart, and do not lean on your own understanding.
reflection: When decisions and paths feel uncertain, surrender your understanding to the Lord's wisdom.
prayer: Father, I surrender my worries and place my trust fully in You today. Amen.

title: Do Not Fear
verse: Fear not, for I am with you; be not dismayed, for I am your God; I will strengthen you, I will help you, I will uphold you with my righteous right hand.
reflection: Whatever battle or challenge lies ahead, you do not face it alone. God's right hand upholds you.
prayer: Lord, replace my fears with the assurance of Your mighty presence. Amen.
